# D07 Years of full-time minimum wage to buy the average home: source values

House prices: HM Land Registry UK HPI, average price seasonally adjusted, January of each year (same values as D02; source CSV https://publicdata.landregistry.gov.uk/market-trend-data/house-price-index-data/Average-price-seasonally-adjusted-2025-06.csv ; spot values also in data/D01_house_prices_by_region.md).
Minimum wage in force on 1 January of each year (adult rate; NLW from Apr 2016), sources as in D05_minimum_wage_vs_prices.md.
Years = price / (rate × 37.5 × 52), rounded to 1 dp. Scotland has no data before 2004 (shown as missing).
